prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence remains thin for all specific kinds of changes because each kind has only been tested once so far.
Adoption new_flow is the only kind of change proven helpful, as it produced a significant winning test.
Predictions were consistently too high across all tests compared to noise-corrected measurements.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: +2.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, copy: +0.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, hint: -2.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: +0.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, redesign: +1.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, wait_info: -0.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, incentive: -3.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: +1.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 63.3%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 18.5%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [finish, redesign] Desktop Launch Companion Showcase: Redesigns the home_intro screen into a stage layout featuring an animated showcase of desktop pet controls and interaction shortcuts. (why: Finish step drops to 64.8% and support received 3 emails from users confused about how to control, hide, or talk to their pet.)
1: [sign_in, reorder] Post-Adoption Account Binding Reorder: Moves the sign_in step to occur right after pet adoption certificate creation so users bond with their pet before creating an account. (why: Sign in currently occurs before pet selection (72.9% conversion), creating early friction before users experience pet customization.)
2: [choose_path, redesign] Split Screen Path & Story Selector: Redesigns choose_path into a split layout displaying path choices alongside dynamic pet previews. (why: choose_path has a high mean time of 514s despite an 8s median, indicating substantial user stalling during path selection.)
3: [home, wait_info] Real-Time Render Progress & Audio Cue: Displays active rendering progress with a cheerful audio chime on the waiting screen while background assets build. (why: Home waiting screen has a high mean duration of 2336 seconds; users need explicit visual and audio cues that pet generation is progressing.)
4: [finish, copy] Desktop Controls Quick Card Summary: Updates home_intro text with concise bullet points detailing right-click menu options, drag controls, and tray shortcuts. (why: Support received 3 emails inquiring how to hide, control, or speak to the pet right after onboarding completion.)
5: [choose_path, notification] Welcome Mascot Voice & Sound Intro: Plays a friendly mascot voice greeting and animated mascot visual on the initial story screen. (why: 76.2% conversion on initial path choice with a high 514s mean time points to early idle drop-offs.)

scores.note: Finish step loses 35.2% of users and both funnel data and support emails highlight confusion. Prior test of finish redesign yielded +1.7% lift.
Sign in step drops 27.1% of users, supported by funnel data. Previous test for sign_in reorder showed a +1.1% lift.
Choose path has 23.8% drop-off and high mean time, but evidence comes only from funnel. Redesigning this step requires significant release cost.
Home step has relatively low drop-off (18.7%). Previous wait_info change on home led to a slight negative lift (-0.3%).
Targets high drop-off finish step supported directly by user emails. Simple copy/text update makes it low cost to deploy.
Funnel indicates idle time at choose_path, but adding sound/voice cues is risky as past hints/prompts on this step performed poorly (-2.7%).
